player.zoomIntro:
Some streams ship 21:9 cinemascope content pasted inside a 16:9 box - the top/bottom black bars are part of the picture itself. Cinema 21:9 mode crops those bars; 4:3 mode does the same for older pillarboxed content.

Press Z on the keyboard to cycle modes.
player.qualityIntro: Highest allowed bandwidth on HLS / DASH streams. Ignored on plain TS / MP4 streams.
